C1404.title: Case Study of the Compound Governance Attack
C1404.summary: In July 2024, the Compound community approved a governance proposal to allocate about $24 million in COMP tokens to a goldCOMP yield strategy promoted by the Golden Boys. Some community members argued that concentrated token holdings and coordinated voting improperly influenced governance and called it a governance attack. The parties later reached an alternative arrangement and withdrew the original transfer plan.
